name: baki-khata
description: Root tooling: Firebase CLI, emulators and rules tests. The app lives in web/.

scripts.emulators: mkdir -p .emulator-data && PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk@21 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore --project demo-baki --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.test:rules: PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk@21 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-baki --only firestore "npm --prefix web run test:rules"
